layouts.name: CDrawingContext_DeviceTarget
layouts.notes: MILComp CDrawingContext rendering paths obtain the device target from this field.

layouts.name: CDrawingContext_GetD2DContextOwner
layouts.notes: CDrawingContext::Create assigns the ID2DContextOwner vtable at this + 16; cross-check the subobject receiver passed by FlushD2D.

layouts.name: CDrawingContext_GetDeviceTransform
layouts.notes: CDrawingContext::UpdateDeviceTransform passes the embedded device transform matrix to CMILMatrix::Multiply.

layouts.name: CDrawingContext_GetWorldTransform
layouts.notes: CDrawingContext::GetWorldTransform3x2 is slot 0 of ID2DContextOwner. Its this pointer is adjusted by 16 bytes; recover the complete-object offset from that subobject displacement and the matrix-stack data/count loads.
